label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_01a
text: I...I almost never saw my mom in my whole life.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_01b
text: I...I almost never saw my dad in my whole life.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_botan_01
text: Oh? Is it time for the backstory reveal?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_rival_01
text: Penny! Shhh![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_02
text: [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0102)]ShHe was always busy with work.\nHardly ever came home.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_03
text: I cooked for myself, cleaned for myself...\nMabosstiff was the only one I had to talk to.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_03a
text: So, yeah, I don’t really know her at all. Even if\nshe is my mom.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_03b
text: So, yeah, I don’t really know him at all. Even if\nhe is my dad.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_04a
text: I tried not to think too much about it. Tried to\njust be proud that she was this famous genius.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_04b
text: I tried not to think too much about it. Tried to\njust be proud that he was this famous genius.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_05
text: But the truth is, I would’ve rather just had a [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad\nwho was there...even if [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0001)]she wasn’t anything great.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_06
text: I haven’t seen h[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]erim for ages now. Unless you count\nseeing h[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]erim in the news or whatever.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_07
text: Used to at least get emails sometimes.\nBut even those stopped a couple years ago.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_08
text: And then there [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0001)]she appears, out of the blue, and\ntells me we’ve gotta come to Area Zero? Tch.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_09
text: Some family, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_botan_04
text: We’re not here to judge or anything...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_botan_05
text: And...I’m sorry about earlier. I shouldn’t have\nsnapped at you like that...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_10
text: Naw, I was also giving you a hard time.\nSorry...uh...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_botan_06
text: Penny. My name’s Penny.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_friend_11
text: You know...you’re actually pretty nice for a little\npipsqueak![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_02_botan_07
text: Heh... Don’t call me pipsqueak, you big lunk.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

text: That’s the spirit, you two![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
